title: 第11章 潜入第12章 斩杀
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
听完周天雄所言，另外三家族长眼睛闪过一抹精芒。
这法似乎值得一试！
他们四大家族联手，派遣出先天强者前去试探李家老祖的虚实，就算不敌，联手之下应该也能脱困。
这样一来，便可试探出李家老祖的底细。
倘若李家老祖只是在虚张声势，那么他们四家便无需继续商讨，直接出手将李家给覆灭了便是！
经过一番深思熟虑之后，莫家族长莫来盛终于打破沉默，他面带微笑，目光如炬地看向周天雄，缓声道：“哈哈，周兄，我莫家同意如此做法，可以派遣一位先天强者同去试探李家老祖的虚实！”
周天雄闻言，心中满意，他微笑着看向莫来盛，点头以示回应。
就在此时，黄家族长黄无极也紧接着发话了。
只见他面带微笑，眼神明亮，朗声道：“周兄所言甚是，我黄家也愿意派遣一名先天强者一同前往李家，一探其中虚实！”
周天雄的笑容更盛了，他转头看向黄无极，同样对其点点头，表示知道。
最后，鹰眼中年袁家族长袁鹰朗也应声回道：“我袁家自然也没有问题！”
他的声音低沉而有力，还带着一股阴冷之色。
周天雄环顾四周，看着这三家族长都对自己的提议表示赞同。
他脸上的笑容愈发灿烂，朗声道：“好，既然诸位都同意派遣先天强者一同前往李家，试探李家老祖的底细，那么此事便如此定下来了。”
他稍稍停顿了一下，接着说道：“不过，此事宜早不宜迟，时间就定在明日子时，不知几位意下如何？”
说罢，他的目光再次扫过莫来盛、黄无极和袁鹰朗三人，似乎在等待他们的回应。
黄家、袁家、莫家这三大家族的族长彼此对视一眼后，紧接着就纷纷开口表示赞同。
“善！”
“可以！”
“如此甚好！”

随着四大家族商讨出计划，这场针对李家的聚首会也随之结束。
……
次日，落凤岭李家与往常一样，族人都在各自忙碌着，一切都显得井然有序。
族内的日常事务通常都是由那些修炼资质相对普通的族人负责处理。
而族中的修士们，则大多都在闭关修炼，只有偶尔才会有一两个修士在族内走动一下，活动活动筋骨。
夜幕降临，万籁俱寂，落凤岭被黑暗所笼罩，一片静谧。
除了李家族地中偶尔闪烁的几点零星灯火外，四周再无其他光亮。
在这片寂静中，后山的大湖宛如一面巨大的镜子，平静地倒映着天空中的点点繁星。
然而，就在这看似平静的湖面之外，四道黑色身影如鬼魅般悄然出现。
且无声无息地穿梭在黑暗之中，他们的身影最终停留在了湖面之上。
这四道身影彼此之间并没有言语交流，但仅仅是一个对视，便似乎已经传递了所有的信息。
紧接着，他们以极快的速度朝着湖心岛方向疾驰而去。
他们的动作迅速而敏捷，身穿着黑色夜行衣仿佛与黑暗融为一体，让人难以察觉到他们的存在。
没过多久，这四道身影便抵达了湖心岛上空。
content_en:
After listening to what Zhou Tianxiong said, the eyes of the other three family heads flashed with gleam.
This method seems worth a try!
The four major families joined forces and sent out innate experts to test the strength of the Li family ancestors. Even if they were defeated, they should be able to get out of trouble by joining forces.
In this way, we can find out the details of the ancestor of the Li family.
If the ancestor of the Li family was just bluffing, then the four of them would not need to continue discussing and just take action to destroy the Li family!
After some careful consideration, Mo Laisheng, the head of the Mo family, finally broke the silence. He looked at Zhou Tianxiong with a smile and said in a slow voice: "Haha, brother Zhou, our Mo family agrees to this. We can send an innate strong man to test the truth of the ancestor of the Li family!"
Zhou Tianxiong was satisfied when he heard this. He looked at Mo Laisheng with a smile and nodded in response.
At this moment, Huang Wuji, the head of the Huang family, also spoke.
He was smiling, his eyes were bright, and he said loudly: "What Brother Zhou said is true. Our Huang family is also willing to send an innate strong man to go to the Li family to find out the truth!"
Zhou Tianxiong's smile became even brighter. He turned to look at Huang Wuji and nodded to him to express his understanding.
Finally, Yuan Yinglang, the elder of the Yuan family in Yingyan, also responded: "My Yuan family naturally has no problem!"
His voice was low and powerful, with a cold tone.
Zhou Tianxiong looked around and saw that the heads of the three families all agreed with his proposal.
The smile on his face became brighter and brighter, and he said loudly: "Okay, since everyone agrees to send innate experts to go to the Li family to test the details of the Li family ancestor, then the matter is settled."
He paused for a moment and then said: "However, this matter should be done sooner rather than later. The time is set for tomorrow. I wonder what you think?"
After saying that, he glanced at Mo Laisheng, Huang Wuji and Yuan Yinglang again, as if waiting for their responses.
The heads of the three major families, the Huang family, the Yuan family, and the Mo family, looked at each other and then spoke in agreement.
"Good!"
"Okay!"
"So good!"
As the four major families discussed the plan, the gathering for the Li family also came to an end.
…
The next day, the Li family in Luofengling was as usual, everyone was busy working on their own, and everything seemed in order.
The daily affairs within the clan are usually handled by clan members with relatively ordinary cultivation qualifications.
Most of the monks in the clan are practicing in seclusion. Only occasionally will one or two monks walk around the clan to stretch their muscles.
As night falls, everything is silent. Luofengling is shrouded in darkness and becomes quiet.
Except for a few scattered lights that occasionally flickered in the Li family grounds, there was no other light around.
In this silence, the big lake in the back mountain is like a huge mirror, calmly reflecting the stars in the sky.
However, just outside this seemingly calm lake, four black figures quietly appeared like ghosts.
And silently shuttled through the darkness, and their figures finally stayed on the lake.
These four figures did not communicate with each other verbally, but just looking at each other seemed to have conveyed all the information.
Immediately afterwards, they galloped towards the island in the middle of the lake at an extremely fast speed.
Their movements are fast and agile, and their black night clothes seem to blend into the darkness, making it difficult for people to detect their presence.
Not long after, these four figures arrived over the island in the middle of the lake.
